params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: foregroundColor
params.description: RGB color value for foreground Returned format depends on the variable's declared type: Text yields a CSS "#rrggbb" string; Integer (Longint) yields a 4-byte 0x00RRGGBB value or a negative value for a system color.

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: RGB color value for background Returned format depends on the variable's declared type: Text yields a CSS "#rrggbb" string; Integer (Longint) yields a 4-byte 0x00RRGGBB value or a negative value for a system color.

params.name: altBackgrndColor
params.description: RGB color value for alternating background Returned format depends on the variable's declared type: Text yields a CSS "#rrggbb" string; Integer (Longint) yields a 4-byte 0x00RRGGBB value or a negative value for a system color.

params.name: borderColor
params.description: Border RGB color, in CSS text or integer format according to the output variable's type; introduced in 21 R5.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns foreground, background and optionally alternating-background and border colors for the designated object(s).

constraints: altBackgrndColor (alternating row background) is only meaningful when object is a list box; when used, backgroundColor applies to odd-numbered rows only.
borderColor requires a form object that supports the borderColor property and is unavailable in binary databases.
